# ScyllaDB Documentation

> Index of all ScyllaDB documentation sites: the database, ScyllaDB Cloud, tools, drivers, and tutorials. Each link points to the llms.txt index of that project, which lists its pages in Markdown. Most projects also publish an llms-full.txt file with their complete content next to their llms.txt.

ScyllaDB is a distributed NoSQL database for real-time applications at high scale. ScyllaDB Cloud is the fully managed service.

Using a coding agent? Install the ScyllaDB agent skills: `npx skills add scylladb/agent-skills --skill scylladb`. More information: https://github.com/scylladb/agent-skills

## Core

- [ScyllaDB Documentation Home](https://docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Getting started, data modeling, CQL basics, overview of drivers, integrations, and version support.
- [ScyllaDB Manual](https://docs.scylladb.com/manual/stable/llms.txt): Install, configure, operate, and troubleshoot ScyllaDB. CQL reference, architecture, Alternator (DynamoDB-compatible API), and upgrade guides.
- [ScyllaDB Cloud](https://cloud.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): The fully managed ScyllaDB service.
- [ScyllaDB Developers](https://developers.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Resources for developers building applications on ScyllaDB.

## Tools

- [ScyllaDB Operator](https://operator.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Run and manage ScyllaDB on Kubernetes.
- [ScyllaDB Manager](https://manager.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Automate repair, backup, and restore of ScyllaDB clusters.
- [ScyllaDB Monitoring Stack](https://monitoring.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Monitoring and alerting for ScyllaDB, based on Prometheus and Grafana.
- [ScyllaDB Migrator](https://migrator.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Migrate data with Spark from Apache Cassandra or DynamoDB to ScyllaDB.

## Drivers

- [Java Driver](https://java-driver.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): ScyllaDB driver for Java.
- [Python Driver](https://python-driver.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): ScyllaDB driver for Python.
- [Python RS Driver](https://python-rs-driver.docs.scylladb.com/llms.txt): Asynchronous ScyllaDB driver for Python, built on top of the Rust driver.
- [Rust Driver](https://rust-driver.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): ScyllaDB driver for Rust.
- [Go Driver (gocql)](https://gocql-driver.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): ScyllaDB driver for Go.
- [C/C++ RS Driver](https://cpp-rs-driver.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): API-compatible rewrite of the C/C++ driver as a wrapper over the Rust driver.
- [C# Driver](https://csharp-driver.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): ScyllaDB driver for C#/.NET.
- [Node.js Driver](https://nodejs-rs-driver.docs.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): ScyllaDB driver for Node.js, built on top of the Rust driver.

## Tutorials and sample applications

- [ScyllaDB Cloud Getting Started](https://cloud-getting-started.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Build a first application with ScyllaDB Cloud.
- [Vector Search](https://vector-search.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Vector search examples with ScyllaDB.
- [Feature Store](https://feature-store.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Build a feature store for machine learning with ScyllaDB.
- [CarePet (IoT)](https://iot.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): IoT sample application.
- [Shopping Cart](https://shopping-cart.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): E-commerce shopping cart sample application.
- [Video Streaming](https://video-streaming.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Video streaming sample application.
- [1M Ops Demo](https://1m-ops-demo.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): ScyllaDB performance demos.

## Optional

- [C/C++ Driver (legacy)](https://cpp-driver.docs.scylladb.com/stable/): Original C/C++ driver. No llms.txt available; see the C/C++ RS Driver above.
- [ScyllaDB Enterprise (legacy)](https://enterprise.docs.scylladb.com/): Documentation for previous ScyllaDB Enterprise releases. No llms.txt available.
- [ScyllaDB Sphinx Theme](https://sphinx-theme.scylladb.com/stable/llms.txt): Toolchain used to build ScyllaDB documentation sites.
- [ScyllaDB University](https://university.scylladb.com/): Free online training courses.
